scope: Read-only deterministic build and QA lessons; NOT model weights, GPU training or release acceptance.

rules.symptom: SourceLock drift or unlike source/archive/Setup identities compared
rules.cause: Git blob, source tree, archive and installed Setup are different SHA scopes
rules.action: Preserve exact CSS->stage->builder source pins; bind E07 to single Setup SHA
rules.prevention: Fail-closed source pin checks before Windows compile

rules.symptom: Repeated heavyweight Windows CI for unchanged historical frozen Setup
rules.cause: Three legacy E07 workflows still subscribed to every shared verifier-source push
rules.action: Preserve manual historical reproduction but remove old automatic push triggers
rules.prevention: Exactly one new candidate E07 auto-trigger, old E07 manual-only

rules.symptom: Independent source tests not individually checked before heavy downloads
rules.cause: Subsequent Python test command overwrote LASTEXITCODE
rules.action: Check every Python unittest command exit immediately
rules.prevention: Regression guard rejects any unguarded source test

rules.symptom: Original UI clicks and source gates misreported as functional or release PASS
rules.cause: Observation receipts confused with privileged operation, OS Reduced Motion or E07 acceptance
rules.action: Keep NOT_TESTED until native owner permissions, effects, physical WebView2 media query and same-Setup E07 evidence
rules.prevention: Source regression requires fail-closed function and reduced-motion acceptance

rules.symptom: E07 fails source regression after producer expands read-only Windows animation evidence
rules.action: Assert WebView2 still NOT_TESTED, Reduced Motion HOLD and current producer shape
rules.prevention: Run focused source test before fetching Ollama or setup

rules.symptom: Repeated fresh install fails after conservative uninstall retains user file
rules.action: Run clean install and Qwen then final destructive lifecycle last; never delete unowned data
rules.prevention: Actual installed NSIS no-loss and same-Setup E07 remain required
